title: Support Us
description: Support the Alpharetta High School Orchestras through participation fees, the patron program, or program book advertising. AHSOA is a 501(c)(3) non-profit.

blocks.title: Help keep the music going
blocks.lede: The Alpharetta High School Orchestra Association is a 501(c)(3) non-profit run entirely by parent volunteers. It funds what the school budget doesn't: sheet music, guest clinicians, instrument maintenance, and travel.

items.title: Student Participation Fee
items.body: The program's primary source of funding. Covers concert uniforms, participation dues, graduation honor cords, Spring Honors Banquet tickets, and field trips.

items.title: Patron Program
items.body: Support the program directly and have your name listed in the concert program book. Open to families, alumni, and anyone in the community who wants to help.

items.title: Program Book Advertising
items.body: Place a personal message or a business ad in the program handed out at every concert. A good fit for local businesses looking to reach orchestra families. [View the 2025–2026 program book](https://www.alpharettaorchestra.com/s/books.pdf).

blocks.heading: Getting in touch
blocks.md:
For questions about payments, payment plans, or anything else financial, contact the Orchestra Booster Treasurer at [treasurerahsorchestra@gmail.com](mailto:treasurerahsorchestra@gmail.com). Anything else goes to [Mr. Hood](/contact).

The AHS Orchestra Association is a member of the Alpharetta High School Athletic Association and is classified as a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. Donations may be tax deductible; consult your tax advisor.
